summary: Collective Mining Ltd. filed a Form 6-K with a press release dated August 18, 2026, reporting operational progress at its Guayabales Project in Colombia. The release details completion of a 1.8-kilometer access road, imminent portal and box-cut activities, and ongoing construction of an exploration adit, with underground drilling scheduled to begin in Q1-2027. This is a routine project update on exploration activities, not a special situation, so no deal terms apply.
